Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Answers below map to your numbered items; I kept responses concise for your questionnaire. I attached a one-page retention summary and our SOC 2 snapshot for evidence. If you need expanded language for a security appendix or DPA, we can provide that as well.

1) Storage location (default and regional pinning)
- Default: request/response payloads and associated model telemetry for hosted API customers are stored in the region of the serving endpoint. For customers created in EU regions, data is stored in EU-only storage and processing nodes (no cross-border replication by default).
- We support region selection at account creation and can route all production traffic to an EU region (Frankfurt or Netherlands) for EU-only residency.

2) Default retention windows
- Request/response payloads (input/output): default 30 days for hosted API. This retention supports quality monitoring, abuse investigations, and model performance debugging.
- Traces/logs/access logs: default 90 days in active hot storage (used for troubleshooting and security investigations), then moved to encrypted cold storage for up to 365 days total unless a shorter retention is requested.
- Backups/snapshots: configuration-dependent; standard backups retained for 90 days. Backups are region-bound for accounts pinned to a region.

3) Deletion flow and SLA
- User/data deletion request flow: 1) Customer opens a ticket or submits a deletion request via the Console/API; 2) We quiesce processing and remove live copies within 72 hours; 3) We schedule purging of backups and cold storage — this step can take up to 30 calendar days depending on snapshot lifecycle and replication windows.
- SLA: for hosted API accounts, Redwood commits to removing live-accessible copies within 72 hours and completing full-propagation deletion (including backups) within 30 days. We will provide a confirmation once the deletion job has completed.

4) Proof of deletion
- We provide a deletion confirmation that includes: request timestamp, objects removed (identifiers), region, and a short audit trace. For enterprise customers we can generate a signed deletion certificate on request.

5) Encryption and KMS support
- Encryption: all data in transit is TLS 1.3; at rest we use AES-256 encryption.
- Customer-managed keys: supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API customers, we support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) via our KMS integration on eligible enterprise plans — we can scope this in the contract/DPA.

Additional notes and edge cases
- Logs used for billing/usage metering are aggregated and retained for 13 months by default for billing dispute resolution; we can configure shorter windows.
- Model weights and third-party model artifacts are never modified by customer payload deletion requests; deletion requests only pertain to customer-submitted data (inputs, outputs, logs, traces).
- EU data residency: for legal/regulated requirements we offer a Private deployment or Dedicated capacity that can be colocated within a customer-managed VPC.

Attachments: redwood-data-residency-and-retention-v1.pdf, SOC2-Type2-snapshot-2025.pdf

If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call today to walk procurement through any of the items — suggest 2pm PT.

Hi Elena — quick clarifications inline below to address the procurement questions.

A) Backups/replicas purge timeline
- The "up to 30 days" window covers the full lifecycle on hosted API (live copies removed in 72 hours; backups/cold storage purged within 30 days). For EU-only accounts we can tighten the internal backup retention policy to a 14–21 day purge window as a contractual option for enterprise customers (this requires a small operational change and is reflected in our enterprise package).

B) Deletion certificate scope
- Yes — our signed deletion certificate can include explicit language that enumerates deleted object IDs and confirms removal from live and backup tiers once the purge job completes. The certificate will note the date the purge completed and the region. During the 30-day window we can provide interim status updates.

C) DPA addendum
- We have a DPA template that includes clauses for retention, deletion SLA, and residency. We can provide a completed DPA for signature (DocuSign link below) that reflects the EU-only backup purge window if you select that option.
